findings.explanation: Both INV-1005 and REC-1005 cite PO-1005 as the governing purchase order, but no purchase order document exists anywhere in the transaction's document set, so the purchase authorization cannot be verified.
REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before the invoice INV-1005 dated 2026-07-21, an inverted receipt-before-invoice sequence that no document explains.
